changelog.title: Release notes for a human
changelog.intro: Every career update since 2022, newest first. Breaking changes are flagged and known issues are disclosed, because that's just good engineering.
changelog.aside: v1.0.0 is the one where someone started paying me. huge release.

shipped.title: Things in production (and in the air)
shipped.intro: Apps on real phones, models on small hardware, machines that move. One index card each.

research.title: Papers, a thesis, and one glove
research.intro: What I do when nobody has filed a ticket: re-checking results that look too good, and making big models behave on hardware that doesn't want them.
research.aside: “unpublished manuscript” means finished and waiting its turn.

receipt.note: Kept the receipt. You never know when someone will ask for proof.
receipt.credit: The rover results belong to all of Team Altair. I wrote the software for the drive, the arm and the autonomy.

manPage.name: rifat — backend engineer, ML tinkerer, occasional drone pilot
manPage.description: Takes a problem and returns a system that solves it, complete with an API contract, a dashboard, and an alert that fires before anyone notices. Runs on curiosity; falls back to occasional panic.
manPage.exitStatus: `0` once it's deployed, monitored and documented. Not before.
bugs: Gets unreasonably excited about exact rational arithmetic.
Treats “works on my machine” as a bug report, not a defence.
Has to be stopped from quantizing things that are not neural networks.
